messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "other medicines are more often involved"
set: ["other medicines are more often involved", "children tested more often", "liver, kidney, and heart function are more often reduced", "doses are usually changed no more often than once a week", "no more often than once a week", "do not take more or less or more often than prescribed", "dose increase no more often than once a week", "tell doctor about all other medicines", "check blood sugar more often when starting, changing, or stopping", "most people are told to eat more potassium", "do not take in higher doses or more often than prescribed", "tell doctor if regularly using other drowsy medicines", "tell doctor or pharmacist about all other medicines", "check blood pressure often", "avoid driving or other dangerous activities until effects are known", "most people do not need more than 50 mg a day when taken alongside other blood pressure medicines"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
